notes.title: Entropy Survivors, the Shoulders of Giants Prequel, is Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]The latest addition to the SOG universe is set before the events of the main game and features totally new gameplay with the seamless co-op and wacky flair you’re already used to.[/b]

Grab it today (with a launch discount!) for the price of a couple energy drinks:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2602030/Entropy_Survivors/

Entropy Survivors is the co-op bullet heaven where you

[list]
[*] roll all the bad guys up into a big ball and explode them 
[*] customize and enhance a massive arsenal of creative sci-fi weapons
[*] turn every world into giant game of pinball
[*] experience it all solo or with best-in-class online support for [b]up to 4 players![/b]
[/list]
Thank you so much for your support. We’d love to hear what you think!
-Kyle

notes.title: Patch 1.9.6 is Released
notes.content:
- Drop-in camera now stops moving when you pause the game
- Fixed bug where magnifying glass could hit robot in best friend mode
- Fixed bug where the Spear air attack could get stuck inside enemies with solid collisions
- Reworked the skill tree UI to be less prone to scaling issues/wiggles/jiggles
- Fixed a case where players could lose a BFM match if the frog spawned too soon before the robot
- The dummy/target health in the hub world scales with HEAT in the late game
- Possible workaround for engine ability system crash
- Balance update: Shield knights now deflect a more forgiving angle of melee attacks.

notes.title: Update 1.9.5 is Live
notes.content:
- Fixed a networking issue that could cause butterfly shot to not work for client players
- Updated some English ability descriptions for clarity
- Deployed turrets now consistently orient properly for client players
- Best Friend Mode: sticky frog projectiles should no longer *ever* attach to your robot best friend (as opposed to merely *usually* not attaching)
- You can now rebind the left and right arrow keys (fixed in 1.9.4)
- Added more instrumentation to crash logs ([b]btw please press "Send" if the game crashes on you![/b]). All reported game crashes have been internal GPU crashes or deep in Unreal's engine code, making them much harder to track down. This extra info will help.

notes.title: Patch 1.9.3 is live
notes.content:
Another small set of fixes and improvements.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where input rebindings would not get saved (big goof on our part here--this worked in development builds but not in the real installed game🙃)
[*] Adjusted some sound effects for storm missions to be less distracting
[*] Fixed a bug where the plasma projectiles would sometimes teleport to the center of the map for multiplayer clients
[*] Butterfly crystals should now be visible on goo enemies
[*] Localization Updates
[/list]

Note for crossplay players: this update is still in the process of releasing everywhere else.

Have a great day!
-Kyle

[h3]This minor update addresses a few small issues: [/h3]

Have fun!

notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.content:
Hello my fellow Deck-heads,

With the release of [i]Shoulders of Giants: Ultimate[/i], we want portable players to have a seamless experience equivalent to those on PC. We have regularly been testing the game on a Steam Deck OLED and believe we’ve got all the bases covered:

[list]
[*] Gameplay was designed from the start to be controller-friendly, and the menu system is navigable via the controller buttons, including text entry for lobby codes!
[*] Playing on Steam Deck will set well-performing graphical settings by default.
[*] You’ll see the correct controller icons.
[*] Text is easily visible in the UI.
[/list]

If you encounter any Steam Deck specific issues, please contact us here or via our [url=https://discord.com/invite/D8B53RbTtj]Discord[/url].

Thank you and have fun!!
-Kyle

[i]Small note to previewers: if you played a pre-release version of the game on Steam Deck you may have encountered an Unreal Engine 5.4 bug that causes the game to constantly prompt you to install and uninstall the Visual C++ runtime. We have contacted Epic to try and get this fixed engine-side, but until then the latest version should have a workaround in place.
[/i]

notes.title: What’s so “Ultimate” about Shoulders of Giants?
notes.content:
Time for a lore dump! [i]Shoulders of Giants[/i] originally released as an exclusive game on multiple non-Steam platforms. We love those platforms because without the exclusivity opportunities this game literally would not exist.

For the first half-year following release, we put out several major updates addressing the game’s weakest aspects and serving up an overflowing ice cream sundae of new content for our fans, including dozens of new abilities, completely overhauled mission objectives, leaderboards, hardcore mode, planet anomalies...

After taking a break to focus on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2602030/Entropy_Survivors/]Entropy Survivors[/url], we’ve finally returned to [i]Shoulders of Giants[/i] with fresh eyes (and expired platform contracts) and molded it into the best game it can be – [b][i]Shoulders of Giants: Ultimate.
[/i][/b]

[h3]There has never been a better time to play Shoulders of Giants![/h3]


The Ultimate release includes the following:
[list]
[*] An upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.
[*] Four new classes, including the freezing Arctic Core and the killer-kawaii Kitty Core!
[*] Thanks to major CPU optimizations for enemies, we have rebalanced the game’s pacing to make worlds feel much more “alive.” You’ll now face many more baddies at once (we’ve adjusted enemy stats to account for this)!
[*] It is now much simpler to influence the results of the crafting system.
[*] Our longest-running community feature request is now in: you can reorder your equipped abilities from the pause menu!
[*] The giant energy crystals that once populated the world of SOG have been replaced by smashable energy crates. It’s fun to smash things.
[*] New planet anomalies.
[*] A major overhaul of UI art for readability and style.
[*] Hundreds of other minor fixes and balance changes.
[/list]

-Kyle

notes.title: Development Report #2
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]

As we gear up to our steam release early next year, we have been busy adding more and more content into the game, check out the features of Entropy update below.

[h1]Update 1.3[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43522611/a3226db7c39e3a17f155acb1a95e7b5756d9ad21.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Bosses and Enemy Variants[/b][/h3]
In this update we added 3 new bosses and 6 new enemy variants. 

[h3][b]New Cores[/b][/h3]
In Shoulders of Giants cores are armor sets with powerful passive or active abilities. In this update we've added 4 more, bringing the current total up to 17. To call out a few in this update we've added a Paladin core which heals allies and deals light damage to foes. There is also the Shogun core which when attacked summons a magical sword that parries attacks. 

[h3][b]New Abilities[/b][/h3]
We've added 12 new fresh abilities. To call out a few there is the rewind ability which as you guessed it, lets you rewind, restoring any health lost and warping you to a previous position in the past. Additionally there is the RC Bomb ability which summons an explosive RC Car which you can steer towards enemies to do massive explosion damage. 

[h3][b]New Planet Mod[/b][/h3]
Fans of Tony Hawk will appreciate our newest planet mod, Grind Rails, which places grindable rails all over planets.

[h3][b]New Shrine Catalyst[/b][/h3]
Added a powerful new healing Shrine.

[h3][b]Various UI Improvements[/b][/h3]
Loads of UI improvements, including a improved end of run stat screen, brand new reworked core icons and more. 

[h3][b]Enemy Spawning Optimizations[/b][/h3]
Optimization's to our spawning code which helps provide a smoother gameplay experience at high heat levels. 

[h3][b]And More![/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Gamepad players no longer have shortcuts on the in-game ability assignment menu (i.e. hitting B to assign a picked up ability to your B ability slot). This can be re-enabled in the options menu.
[*]Various performance optimizations
[*]Various bug fixes, including several crash bugs
[*]Full refresh of force feedback for gamepad players
[*]Better sound attenuations
[/list]

notes.title: Development Report #1
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]

Shoulders of Giants 1.0 released in January of this year on Epic Games and Xbox. As we gear up towards our Steam release we wanted to share all of the updates we've added since then.

[h1]Update 1.1[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43522611/231b98ebc03e24c2d401c1bd8ebc9341ca808880.png[/img]

In our first update after 1.0, we added 3 new features to the game, Owl's Protection, Hardcore Mode, and ranked leaderboards.

[h3][b]Owls Protection:[/b][/h3]
This feature, geared toward newer players, grants you an extra boost when you lose multiple planets in a row. Protection can be turned on or off at any time by speaking with the Owl in-game.

[h3][b]Hardcore Mode[/b][/h3]
When you are defeated, this save will be deleted. Perfect for those seeking extra bragging rights and a classic Roguelike experience. Not for first-time players!

[h1]Update 1.2[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43522611/d3d1dda8ecea72099c8f8e0ed93a2733f1491261.png[/img]

Our second update added a ton of new content to the game, and includes huge improvements to the core level modes.

[h3][b]Improved Level Modes[/b][/h3]
Even our biggest fans agreed: the game needed more level variety. We completely overhauled the game's mission types to make them far more unique and interesting.

For our Conquest mode, there are now several different spire types players will encounter instead of just one. For Storm, this mode was revamped so players now work to activate and defend light probes. For Hunt, instead of just defeating enemies in general, this mode now requires you to hunt special targets that are more challenging. 

[h3][b]New Arena Experience[/b][/h3]
Fight hordes of enemies inside challenging hidden indoor arenas. Beat them to unlock extra rewards!

[h3][b]8 New Abilities[/b][/h3]
We expanded the arsenal of abilities to well over 50+ now, with notable additions like anti-air missiles, enemy-encasing bubbles and bouncing grape grenades.

[h3][b]New Planet Anomaly System[/b][/h3]
This brand new system modifies attributes of the landscape and enemy forces. Experience a low gravity world, or one with shifting tectonic plates and a shower of meteors. Fight Berserker enemies that have half health, but double damage, or enemies that regenerate health. 

Well be posting another update soon, stay tuned!
